fields.notes: PSI5 does not ship a formal testbench, but the specification implies a verification plan covering the current-loop physical layer, current modulation, Manchester coding, synchronous/asynchronous modes, telegram framing + CRC/parity, the topologies, and the bit rates.
verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Two-wire current loop — loop-powered sensor; power + data on the same wires.
Current modulation — +-26 mA current pulses; ECU current sensing.
Manchester coding — embedded bit clock; ECU timing recovery.
Synchronous mode — sync pulse triggers time-slot transmission.
Time-division — multiple sensors in distinct time slots on a parallel bus.
Telegram framing — start condition + data + optional region/status + CRC/parity.
Error check — 2-bit/3-bit CRC or parity; corrupted telegrams discarded.
Topologies — point-to-point, parallel bus, daisy-chain (universal timing).
Fault handling — out-of-range current, missing telegram, lost sync pulse.
